text:
Everything takes on in my mouth
a lasting taste of tears:
the daily meal, the song,
even prayer.


I have no other trade,
after the silent work of loving you,
than this hard trade of tears
you left me.


Eyes squeezed shut
with hot tears!
Troubled, convulsed mouth,
where everything becomes a prayer!


I am ashamed
to live this cowardly way!
I neither go in search of you
nor can I forget you!


Remorse bleeds me
when I look at a sky
your eyes cannot see,
when I touch the roses
nourished by the lime of your bones!


Flesh of misery,
shameful, weary branch,
that will not lie down beside you,
that presses, trembling,
to Life's impure breast!
